title: Ski pass map
offline: Map tiles need a connection. Resort data is stored in the app.
passMatchAnyHint: Shows a resort when at least one pass you picked covers it.
passMatchAllHint: Shows a resort only when every pass you picked covers it.
klimaHint: Resorts with a train or bus note. This is not a checked connection.
unknownHidden: Missing snow park, night skiing, elevation, or piste length is unknown. Those resorts stay hidden while that filter is on.
showClosed: Show areas marked abandoned in OpenStreetMap
showClosedHint: Hidden by default. The tag comes from OpenStreetMap, not a live closure list. A name search still finds them.
favouritesHint: Only resorts you saved on this device.
geoDenied: Location is blocked. Allow it from the address-bar lock, then try again.
geoUnsupported: This browser has no location service.
geoTimeout: Your location could not be found. Turn on location services on this device, then try again.
straightLine: Distances are straight-line, not drive time or a timetable.
legendKlima: Distance uses a reference place you save on this device, or your location when you ask for it.
legendClosed: A faded dot is marked abandoned in OpenStreetMap. These stay hidden unless you show them in the filters.
mapError: The map could not be drawn. The list still works.
noPasses: No pass in this dataset covers this resort.
setBirthYearHintPrefix: Adult prices are shown until you add a birth year in
hiddenByFilters: Current filters hide this resort on the map.
noBirthYear: Set a birth year to see your price.
noBracket: No tariff for this birth year.
presaleNotStarted: No price yet. The next price starts {date}.
afterDeadline: The price after this deadline is not in the data.
childUnknown: Child price is not in the data.
compareIntro: Prices follow the birth year and purchase date from the planner. Missing prices stay unknown.
purchaseHelp: Leave it and the planner uses today. That is what selects the early-bird window.
addDaysPrompt: Add planned days to compare passes, two-pass combinations, and day tickets.
savedLocally: Favourites, birth year, and planned days stay in this browser only.
checkOfficial: Check the official site before you pay. These prices can go stale.
globalDisclaimer: Information may be incomplete, outdated or wrong. Always check the official website before buying.
statsAggregate: Includes sub-areas, so this figure is left out of filters and totals.
pisteTotal: {km} km of piste on the map. Areas that contain other areas are not added again.
disclaimer: Prices here were collected for the 2026/27 season and are not updated live. Buy only after checking the pass website. Straight-line distance is not a drive time or a train connection.
updatedUnknown: No update date in the data file.
seedBody: Skimap starts with Austria, plus a few neighbouring areas. Coordinates come from OpenStreetMap and OpenSkiMap. Pass coverage and prices come from the operators' own websites. Resorts found only on commercial portals stay off the map until they are checked.
gapsBody: Missing values stay blank. Snow park and night skiing are shown only when an official page says so. Piste kilometres and lift counts come from OpenStreetMap. Areas that contain other areas are left out of those totals and out of the length and lift filters. A day ticket from a season other than 2026/27 is marked as an estimate.
storageBody: Saved resorts, birth year, purchase date, planned days and your location stay in this browser on this device. Shared links contain the filters and the open resort, never your coordinates. Consent for the Mapbox map is stored separately and stays off until you allow it.
pwaBody: The app can be installed and keeps its pages and data for offline use. The map itself needs a connection.
osm: Vector base map © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles, or Mapbox when that provider is in use.
unverifiedHeld: {n} more resorts are in the data but stay hidden until they are verified.
creditsOsm: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Map data is available under the Open Database Licence.
creditsOpenSkiMap: OpenSkiMap, for ski-area locations derived from OpenStreetMap.
creditsOpenFreeMap: OpenFreeMap and © OpenMapTiles draw the vector base map when Mapbox is not used. Data from OpenStreetMap.
creditsMapbox: Mapbox draws the base map on your first 3 visits and for supporters, when a token, your consent and the monthly load budget allow it. © Mapbox © OpenStreetMap.
creditsOpenSnowMap: © www.opensnowmap.org (CC BY-SA) for the optional piste overlay.
creditsTerrain: Relief and 3D terrain: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data (DGM Österreich, EU-DEM, SRTM).
creditsPasses: Season-pass prices and resort lists are taken from each operator's own website. Check that site before you pay.
creditsCode: {name} application code is all rights reserved until the owner chooses a licence.
notFound: That page is not on this map.
ageNotBirthYear: This pass is priced by age at purchase, not birth year. The adult and child prices are listed separately.
liftMotionHint: Cabins, chairs and hangers run along the lifts. The lift signs stay on the map when this is off.
pisteEmpty: No OpenStreetMap pistes in range of this resort.
osmLicence: Base map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). The drawing is OpenFreeMap with OpenMapTiles, or Mapbox when that provider is in use. Resort coordinates and piste lines are from OpenStreetMap and OpenSkiMap, also under the ODbL. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
opensnowmapLicence: The optional “Show all pistes” layer uses OpenSnowMap pistes-only tiles (CC BY-SA). Tiles load only for the area on screen. https://www.opensnowmap.org/
birthYearExact: With a birth year, the matching tariff is highlighted. Without one, the adult price is shown and the other published tariffs are listed underneath.
referencePlaceHint: Saved only on this device. Used for straight-line distance. Not added to links.
noSavedPlace: No reference place yet. Distances stay hidden until you save a city or use your location.
noPlaceMatch: No listed city matches that text. Try a city name, or use your location.
searchAsMove: Search as I move the map
paysOffAvg: Pays off after about {n} ski days
dayTicketAdultNote: Day tickets use each resort's adult price.
showRuns: Show runs and lifts on map
youSave: You save {amount} vs day tickets only
dayTicketsWin: Day tickets are cheapest for this plan.
planEmpty: Add resorts from the map, or search here.
supportBody: Skimap.eu is free and needs no account. If it helps you plan your season, you can support it.
legendPill: Each dot is a resort in the colour of the pass that covers it. A ring in a second colour means a second pass covers it too. Zoom in to see pass names under the resort names.
legendEmpty: A small grey dot is a resort that no pass in this data covers.
legendRing: A number in a circle groups nearby resorts; tap it to zoom in. A dark ring marks a resort in your plan.
listHandle: Resize the list. Arrow up expands it, arrow down shortens it.
resortHandle: Resize the resort card. Arrow up expands it, arrow down shortens it to the name, then to the handle.
metaDescription: Skimap.eu compares season passes and day tickets for Austrian ski resorts, season 2026/27. No account needed, and your data stays in your browser.
contactIntro: Send a message about the map, the data, or your privacy rights. No account is required. We do not send email from this form; messages are stored for review.
contactEmailHint: Optional. Only used if we need to reply.
contactResortIdHint: Optional. The id from the resort sheet or data file.
contactPrivacyConsent: I have read the privacy note.
contactSuccess: Thank you. Your message was received.
contactFailure: Could not send your message. Try again later.
contactRateLimited: Too many messages from this connection. Try again in an hour.
contactTurnstileError: Security check failed. Refresh the page and try again.
contactValidationError: Check the form fields and try again.
legalFallbackNote: The legal texts are available in English and Hungarian.
consentBannerIntro: Optional: load the map from Mapbox (may store data on your device). If you decline, we keep using the free OpenFreeMap tiles with no extra consent. Details:
consentNecessaryBody: These items work without asking for consent:
consentMapCategoryDesc: Loads Mapbox tiles and may store technical data on your device when you choose this instead of OpenFreeMap.
supportPromptHeadline: Skimap is free. Want fewer reminders?
supportPromptMapPerk: Supporters also get the more detailed Mapbox map.
supportPromptRewarded: Watch a short ad – no reminders for 2 days
supportCodeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
supportCodeError: Couldn't check the code right now. Try again later.
affiliateDisclosure: These links may earn a commission. They never change map ranking.
clearAllConfirm: Remove favourites, plan days, and saved places on this device?
defaultAdultHint: Prices use the adult bracket when no birth year is set.
mapboxMapHelper: Mapbox draws a more detailed map. With your consent it is on for your first {n} visits; after that the free OpenFreeMap map is used.
mapboxSupporterPerk: Supporters get the Mapbox map back for a while.
mapProviderNowFreeNoToken: Now showing: free map (no Mapbox token)
mapAccessTrial: Mapbox map is on. Free visits left after this one: {n}.
mapAccessTrialLast: Mapbox map is on for your last free visit.
mapAccessSupporter: Mapbox map is on until {date}. Thanks for supporting Skimap!
mapAccessUsed: Free map now: all {n} free Mapbox visits are used.
terrain3dHint: Tilts the map to show the mountains and runs when you open a resort.
savedEmpty: No saved resorts yet. Tap the heart on a resort card.
